solution.title: Microsoft Tunnel for MAM — Mobile Access to Intranet Resources

products.name: Microsoft Tunnel for MAM — Mobile Access to Intranet Resources — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to deploy Microsoft Tunnel and Tunnel for MAM — an app-level VPN that routes MAM-protected mobile-app traffic to internal/intranet resources, scoped to the app rather than the whole device. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Let managed mobile apps reach intranet resources — without a full device VPN

Some corporate resources only live inside the network — an on-prem app, an internal API, a private intranet endpoint — and mobile users on BYOD can't reach them without a VPN you'd rather not put on a personal phone. Microsoft Tunnel for MAM solves this: an app-level VPN that routes traffic from MAM-protected Microsoft 365 (and line-of-business) apps to internal resources, scoped to the app rather than the whole device. This solution gives you a repeatable way to deploy the Microsoft Tunnel Gateway and Tunnel for MAM so managed mobile apps reach intranet resources securely.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Microsoft Tunnel and Tunnel for MAM work (the Linux-hosted Tunnel Gateway, the connector, split vs. full tunneling), how app-level VPN differs from device VPN, and which apps/resources it fits.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, a supported Linux host / container for the Tunnel Gateway, network/firewall paths to internal resources, certificates, the MAM apps in scope, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the Tunnel Gateway, configure the server + site + connector, create the Tunnel for MAM configuration, target the MAM apps, validate mobile app access to an internal resource, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Tunnel/MAM readiness discovery, per-device/app tunnel-connectivity validation, a tunnel usage and health report, safe remediation of unhealthy config, and a Tunnel-for-MAM scope-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Managed mobile apps able to reach internal intranet resources — through an app-scoped Microsoft Tunnel for MAM rather than a whole-device VPN — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TUNMAM-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Microsoft Tunnel sites/servers/configs + Tunnel (MAM) config (Graph)
    • TUNMAM-Remediation.ps1 — safely remediate an unassigned Tunnel (MAM) configuration (Graph)
    • TUNMAM-Report.ps1 — Microsoft Tunnel usage + health report (Graph)
    • TUNMAM-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — set the pilot/broad group on the Tunnel (MAM) configuration (Graph)
    • TUNMAM-Validation.ps1 — validate Tunnel server health + MAM config targeting (Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
